texts.traversal: its path leaves the evidence directory.
texts.invalid_entry: its manifest entry is incomplete or malformed.
texts.symlink: it is a symbolic link or sits under one.
texts.not_regular: it is not a regular file.
texts.not_png: it is not a PNG image.
texts.total_limit: the run's evidence passed 100 MiB in total.
texts.unbound: captured from a different base or candidate than this pull request.
texts.transfer_failed: it could not be copied out of the run.
texts.timeout: it ran out of time before it could be published.
texts.not_stored: it was not stored before publishing.
texts.head_changed: captured from a different candidate than this pull request head.
texts.not_shown_size: it did not fit in this comment.

conventions.checkout: A git repository whose prepared base P commits .gitignore (exactly '.curie/ui-evidence/\n'), README.md and src/app.py. HEAD is one more commit on P changing src/app.py. 'clean' leaves the worktree at HEAD, so C equals HEAD's tree; 'dirty' adds an uncommitted README.md edit and an untracked src/feature.py, so C differs from HEAD's tree. C is computed independently of runner code: GIT_INDEX_FILE=<scratch> git read-tree HEAD, git add -A, git write-tree.
conventions.manifest: fixture.manifest is written to .curie/ui-evidence/manifest.json as JSON after the selectors add base_sha (base), head_sha (head), candidate_dirty and candidate_tree (tree); a null selector omits the key. fixture.manifest_raw, when a string, is written verbatim instead. Both null: no manifest file.

selectors.base: P = the prepared base, other = oids.other_base, null = omitted
selectors.head: HEAD = the checkout's HEAD commit, null = omitted
selectors.tree: C = the candidate tree, other = oids.other_tree, null = omitted

conventions.files: Paths are relative to .curie/ui-evidence/. {png: valid} is a real PNG (signature, IHDR, zlib IDAT, IEND, correct CRCs) whose pixels differ per path; crc corrupts one chunk CRC; ihdr_not_first puts a valid tEXt chunk before IHDR; iend_not_last appends a valid tEXt chunk after IEND; not_png has no PNG signature; oversized is a valid PNG padded with a tEXt chunk to max_image_bytes + 1. {symlink: t} is a symbolic link to t; {dir_symlink: t} is a directory symbolic link to t.

placeholders.$size: byte length of this image entry's fixture file
placeholders.$sha256: lowercase hex sha256 of this image entry's fixture file

conventions.image_entries: size and sha256 are null unless the PNG passed validation (refusal null, unbound, total_limit, transfer_failed or timeout). bound is false for every refusal up to and including unbound, true otherwise. An invalid or absent manifest computes no binding, so its candidate_tree and head_tree are null. head_tree is computed only when candidate_dirty is exactly false and head_sha is present.
conventions.runner: A subset of the /v1/ui-evidence/index 200 body: every key listed must match.
conventions.index: The full worker-to-API index (PUT .../ui-evidence body), or null when nothing is uploaded.
conventions.api: comment: none (no evidence comment), evidence (at least one image shown), outcome (an outcome comment showing no image), unsupported (the host cannot show evidence). shown: ordinals rendered as images. not_shown: ordinal (as a string) to refusal code, rendered with texts[code].

faults.transfer: worker and runner: after the index is read, the after image file (ordinal 1) is rewritten with a different valid PNG, so the image route answers 409 image_changed.
faults.capture_timeout: worker: the runner's image route stalls past the capture budget, so no image is fetched.
faults.upload_rejection: API: the index PUT is refused with a 4xx; the worker sends nothing else.
faults.storage: API: storing ordinal 1's bytes fails with 503 ui_evidence.storage_unavailable on every attempt; ordinal 0 stores.
faults.host_unsupported: API: the code host declares store_evidence unsupported.
faults.comment: API: every evidence comment write fails until the publish deadline.
faults.publish_timeout: API: hosting the images outlasts the publish budget before any image is stored.

cases.summary: No manifest: the run produced no evidence, nothing is uploaded or commented.
A manifest that is not JSON is reported as an invalid manifest with no images.
Entries whose path leaves the evidence directory are refused; the valid before image still binds.
An image that is a symbolic link to a valid PNG is refused.
An image under a directory that is a symbolic link is refused even though the target is a valid PNG.
A file without the PNG signature is refused.
A PNG whose chunk CRC does not match is refused.
A PNG whose first chunk is not IHDR is refused.
A PNG with a chunk after IEND is refused.
A structurally valid PNG one byte over 10 MiB is refused.
The manifest lists an after image whose file does not exist; only the before image is shown.

manifest.reason: the after render did not finish

runner.reason: the after render did not finish

index.reason: the after render did not finish

cases.summary: A before image captured against another base is unbound; the after image bound to C is shown.

candidate_dirty true with head_sha = HEAD and no candidate_tree: after is unbound even though the checkout is clean and HEAD's tree equals C, because head_sha is never consulted unless candidate_dirty is exactly false.
candidate_dirty omitted with head_sha = HEAD and no candidate_tree: after is unbound on a clean checkout whose HEAD tree equals C.
candidate_dirty false with head_sha = HEAD on a checkout with uncommitted changes: HEAD's tree differs from C, so after is unbound.
candidate_dirty false with head_sha = HEAD on a clean checkout: HEAD's tree equals C, so after binds.
The after file is rewritten between the index and the image read, so the runner answers image_changed and the worker reports transfer_failed.
The API cannot store the after image (503 ui_evidence.storage_unavailable on every attempt), so it is reported not_stored.
The API refuses the index with a 4xx; nothing else is uploaded and no comment is written.
The code host declares store_evidence unsupported; the comment says it cannot show evidence.
Every comment write fails through the publish deadline; no comment exists.
The runner's image route stalls past the capture budget; every unfetched image is timeout.
Hosting the images outlasts the publish budget; the outcome comment reports them as timed out.
Before bound to P and after bound to C: both are shown.
